subject: Mustang Report Episode 3
overview: Medford High School students present episode three of the Mustang Report, covering community and school news including the 385th Medford Parade, athletics, a building leak, and a school-wide t-shirt campaign.

items.title: Studio Introduction
items.summary: Student hosts open the segment discussing recent athletics, local charity events, and upcoming broadcast topics.

items.title: 385th Medford Parade Coverage
items.summary: Reporters interview student-athletes, coaches, and costumed participants marching in the 385th Medford Parade.

items.title: Weather Update
items.summary: Carrie Anne Lucharis reports on a flash flood warning and heavy rainfall expected in the area.

items.title: Teacher Marathon Training Segment
items.summary: Katrina Rasche interviews English teacher Max Heinegg about his 18-week marathon training program.

items.title: School Building Flooding Report
items.summary: Carrie Anne Lucharis and Lydia Ryan report on interior leaking and rain cleanup near 3rd Cap caused by a damaged roof drain pipe.

items.title: "What Would Tucci Do?" Campaign Feature
items.summary: Reporters speak with Dr. John Perella, students, and Nick Tucci regarding the popular "What Would Tucci Do?" t-shirt initiative.
